title: ASARS Telecom-SLA Profile v0.1-draft
description: ASARS payload extension for 5G SLA, C-V2X, and URLLC-oriented edge measurement. Draft — developed with input from 5G edge practitioners and lab or field trial data. Validate TEID semantics and KPI definitions with live RAN/core data before production.

telecom_context.description: 5G / edge networking context at the measurement demarcation point (e.g. UPF user-plane treatment).

teid.description: Tunnel Endpoint ID or deployment-equivalent session identifier (3GPP-aligned where applicable).

gsma_nest_type.description: GSMA NG.116 NEST / slice service category.

gsma_ng116_sla_attribute.description: Specific NG.116 GST / SLA attribute identifier being measured.

latency_measured_ms.description: Observed latency in milliseconds (one-way vs RTT defined by observer).

sla_threshold_ms.description: Committed or evaluated SLA latency threshold in milliseconds.

packet_loss_rate.description: Packet or frame loss rate (0–1 fraction or PPM per observer convention — document in implementation).

sla_result.description: Domain SLA result. Map to core outcome: sla_met → allowed; sla_breach → blocked (unless local policy inverts labels).

correlated_receipt_id.description: Identifier linking to a correlated AI or control-plane ASARS receipt (for example a UUID shared across correlating observability systems).

outcome.description: Core ASARS outcome: allowed if SLA met / path acceptable; blocked if breach or policy block.

notes: Confirm field names against GSMA NG.116 attribute IDs and 3GPP KPI definitions (e.g. TS 28.552). correlated_receipt_id bridges network and autonomy receipt chains when both are attested.
